feedback_text: The new analytics dashboard loads 10x faster than before. Really appreciate the keyboard shortcuts and clean typography!
Exporting raw feedback to CSV fails with gateway 504 timeout whenever the table has more than 500 records.
My credit card was charged twice for the team seat upgrade. Please refund duplicate charge $120 to sarah.jenkins@techcorp.io.
Love the clean editorial design and dark mode previews. It is so much easier to read at night.
Checkout completely freezes on mobile Safari after entering 3DS confirmation code from my bank.
Can you please add support for webhook payload testing directly from the developer settings?
Search bar doesn't return any results when searching for multiple keywords separated by commas.
App crashed twice when switching between overview and theme tabs on iOS 18. Please fix urgently.
Customer support resolved our SSO migration issue within 15 minutes. Best onboarding experience we have had.
The automated theme discovery helped us identify our mobile cart drop-off immediately after the release.
Invoice PDF generation is missing our company VAT number and European tax identifier.
Urgent: Unable to log in with Google OAuth since this morning. Reach me at 415-555-0199 or alex.m@startup.co.
Filter presets on the feedback list save our team hours every week. Fantastic update!
Webhooks are dropping event deliveries intermittently with HTTP 429 rate limit errors.
Very intuitive navigation and fast response times. Everything feels snappy and responsive.
Pricing is reasonable for mid-size teams but annual billing discount could be more competitive.
Table sorting by quality score resets whenever I navigate between pagination pages.
Need the ability to export synthesized theme reports to PDF for executive presentations.
Push notifications for critical sentiment alerts arrived with a 2-hour delay yesterday.
The Hindsight memory feature accurately connected our October checkout bug to last month's incident.
API rate limits are too restrictive for batch sentiment classification across 50,000 records.
Two-factor authentication SMS codes are sometimes taking up to 5 minutes to arrive on Vodafone.
Great app overall! Would love to see an iPad tablet optimized view with side-by-side comparison.
PII redaction automatically caught credit card patterns before they reached our analytics. Super impressed.
Solid feedback synthesizer. Replaced three disconnected survey tools into a single intelligence console.
